lines.text: Many learners say: I eat lunch already.

native.tip: 中文用“了”表示完成，动词本身不变。英语要把动词变成过去式：eat 变成 ate。
native.caption: 你是不是也会说 “I eat lunch already.”😅 中文用“了”表示已经吃过，动词不变，英语要把 eat 变成 ate：“I ate lunch already.”跟着 Ama 老师读一读！在 Lexkite 应用里练习更多。
native.comment: 答案：“I ate lunch already.”大声读一遍，再写一句你自己的句子。免费测验在这里：{link}

en.hook: Change the verb for the past!
en.tip: Chinese uses 了 and the verb stays the same. English changes the verb: eat becomes ate.
en.caption: Do you say “I eat lunch already.” 😅 Chinese uses 了 and the verb stays the same, but English changes eat to ate: “I ate lunch already.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
